questions.stem: A layer takes 3 inputs and produces 4 outputs, and each output has its own bias. How many parameters (weights plus biases) does the layer have?
questions.explain: There is one weight for each input-output pair, 3 × 4 = 12, plus one bias per output, 4. The total is 16.
